fixtures.name: terminal.attach.format_is_text_or_bytes
fixtures.about: A format that is neither word is bad_request naming it.

fixtures.name: terminal.attach.text_format_is_unchanged
fixtures.about: Asking for text by name is the default: the snapshot has rows and no byte fields. Needs --var terminal_agent.

fixtures.name: terminal.attach.the_daemon_says_it_serves_bytes
fixtures.about: A daemon that serves bytes says so in hello, per host. Needs --var bytes_agent (a tmux terminal).

fixtures.name: terminal.attach.bytes_snapshot_shape
fixtures.about: The bytes snapshot: base64 data whose rows end in CR LF and never a bare LF, the size, the cursor, the alternate-screen flag, a history page of strings, the holders. Needs --var bytes_agent.

fixtures.name: terminal.attach.a_text_only_host_refuses_bytes
fixtures.about: A terminal whose host cannot serve bytes is refused, gate unsupported, and nothing is attached. Needs --var text_only_agent.

fixtures.name: terminal.history.bytes_lines_are_strings
fixtures.about: History in bytes is strings with their codes, one physical row each, the same paging as text. Needs --var bytes_agent.

fixtures.name: terminal.history.format_is_text_or_bytes
fixtures.about: A format that is neither word is bad_request naming it.

fixtures.name: terminal.bytes.output_follows_the_snapshot
fixtures.about: After the snapshot the next notice is seq + 1 (no gap, no repeat) and typed output arrives as output notices above it. Needs --var bytes_agent: a tmux terminal at a shell prompt.

fixtures.name: terminal.bytes.reconnect_from_a_snapshot
fixtures.about: A client that attaches again repaints from the new snapshot, which holds what was printed before, and the first notice after it is seq + 1. Needs --var bytes_agent.

fixtures.name: terminal.bytes.alt_screen_is_in_the_snapshot
fixtures.about: A pane on the alternate screen says so, and the snapshot data starts by switching to it. Needs --var bytes_agent.

fixtures.name: terminal.bytes.resize_gives_watchers_a_snapshot
fixtures.about: A watcher on bytes is told of the holder's resize, and of the restore, by a snapshot notice with the new size and no resize notice. Not even the holder may go under 80 by 24: refused, gate input_holder. Needs --var bytes_agent.

fixtures.name: terminal.bytes.a_viewer_resizes_when_nobody_holds
fixtures.about: With nobody holding the input, any connection that has the terminal attached resizes it, down to 80 by 24, and the last resize wins. Every attach hears it: a bytes attach by a snapshot, a text attach by a resize notice. Under 80 by 24 the resize is refused, gate input_holder. When the last attach goes, the size from before the first of those resizes is given back. Needs --var bytes_agent.

fixtures.name: terminal.bytes.slow_client_gets_a_snapshot_not_a_gap
fixtures.about: A watcher that reads nothing while 16 MiB are printed is sent one snapshot notice, reason slow_client, above every seq it missed; the connection stays open. The count is bytes, not seconds. Needs --var bytes_agent.

fixtures.name: terminal.input.refused_to_a_non_holder
fixtures.about: While the daemon holds the input nobody may send raw input: refused, gate input_holder. Needs --var terminal_handle: the handle of an agent's terminal nobody holds.

fixtures.name: terminal.input.data_is_base64_and_bounded
fixtures.about: Data that is not base64, is empty, or decodes to more than 16384 bytes is bad_request naming it.

fixtures.name: terminal.input.needs_a_request_id
fixtures.about: A write without a request_id is bad_request naming it.

fixtures.name: terminal.input.unknown_terminal_is_not_found
fixtures.about: A handle no agent has is not_found.

fixtures.name: terminal.input.an_agent_session_is_refused_by_role
fixtures.about: The channel is a person's: a call from an agent session is refused, gate role.

fixtures.name: terminal.bytes.a_second_attach_replaces_the_first
fixtures.about: A second attach of the same terminal and format on one connection is accepted and replaces the first: the reply is a new snapshot, and the notices after it come once, each one above the last. Needs --var bytes_agent.

fixtures.name: terminal.bytes.text_and_bytes_attaches_coexist
fixtures.about: A text attach and a bytes attach of one terminal on one connection are independent: each gets the holder notice with its own format and its own counter, and the bytes attach is not told by a frame. Needs --var bytes_agent.

fixtures.name: terminal.bytes.detach_names_a_format
fixtures.about: Detaching one format ends only that attach: the other goes on with its counter. Detaching with no format ends every attach of the terminal, and a second detach with nothing to end is accepted. Needs --var bytes_agent.

fixtures.name: terminal.detach.format_is_text_or_bytes
fixtures.about: A format that is neither word is bad_request naming format.

fixtures.name: terminal.attach.styled_snapshot_shape
fixtures.about: A styled attach replies with the text snapshot's shape and format styled; a row's spans, when it has them, are runs with from, to and a style object (their order and non-overlap are in the spec). Needs --var styled_agent (a terminal whose host lists styled).

fixtures.name: terminal.attach.a_host_without_attributes_refuses_styled
fixtures.about: A terminal whose host cannot give cell attributes is refused styled, gate unsupported, and nothing is attached. Needs --var text_only_agent.
